title: Multimodal large language models in remote sensing: a tutorial-oriented review
title_zh: 遥感中的多模态大语言模型：教程导向综述
abstract: Research on remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) has advanced rapidly in recent years, but existing studies remain scattered across different model architectures and application tasks, highlighting the need for a systematic synthesis to establish a clear overall understanding of the field. In addition, most existing surveys on RS-MLLMs narrowly focus on early vision-language models (VLMs) or merely provide catalogs of architectures and datasets. This paper presents a comprehensive review of RS-MLLMs from both system-level and task-oriented perspectives on a tutorial-oriented basis. First, the necessity of RS-MLLMs is discussed by examining the domain gap and internal heterogeneity of RS data, the limitations of visual-only paradigms, and the transitional role of VLMs. Subsequently, the system-level evolution of RS-MLLMs is comprehensively summarized, including architectural components, training and fine-tuning strategies, evaluation, and RS-Agent paradigms. Meanwhile, downstream RS-MLLM applications are analyzed with a unified capability-oriented taxonomy, covering language generation, visual question answering, grounding and localization, cross-modal retrieval, and temporal change understanding. Finally, the current challenges of RS-MLLMs are discussed, and future research directions, including parameter-efficient adaptation, spatio-temporal reasoning, and knowledge-driven architectures, toward more reliable, efficient, and geospatially aware multimodal intelligence, are envisioned.
abstract_zh: 近年来，遥感多模态大语言模型（RS-MLLMs）的研究迅速发展，但现有研究仍分散于不同的模型架构和应用任务中，凸显出需要进行系统性综合，以建立对该领域的清晰整体认知。此外，现有的大多数RS-MLLMs综述狭隘地关注早期视觉-语言模型（VLMs），或仅提供架构和数据集目录。本文基于教程导向的视角，从系统层面和面向任务的层面对RS-MLLMs进行了全面综述。首先，通过考察RS数据的领域差距和内部异质性、纯视觉范式的局限性以及VLMs的过渡作用，讨论了RS-MLLMs的必要性。随后，全面总结了RS-MLLMs的系统层面演进，包括架构组件、训练和微调策略、评估以及RS-Agent范式。同时，采用统一的能力导向分类体系对下游RS-MLLM应用进行了分析，涵盖语言生成、视觉问答、基定与定位、跨模态检索以及时序变化理解。最后，讨论了RS-MLLMs的当前挑战，并展望了面向更可靠、高效且具备地理感知的多模态智能的未来研究方向，包括参数高效适配、时空推理和知识驱动架构。
